title: Import and restore
note: Import replaces the destination universe with archive state; save a backup before replacing data you need. Local import uses yoke universe import ARCHIVE against the selected local universe, revokes copied API tokens and browser sessions, and binds the machine owner as admin. Self-host import uses yoke self-host import ARCHIVE --dir BUNDLE with the destination core stopped, revokes copied API tokens and browser sessions, and returns one fresh admin token. Hosted Import revokes copied API tokens and browser sessions; reconnect and sign in through destination authority. Self-host handoff failures print bounded exec stderr/stdout, container logs, exit codes and container OOM/memory state before removing the import container, with API tokens and the bundle database password redacted; repair the diagnosed cause and retry. An import supervisor holds the container alive until the private exec bridge returns; nonzero bridge exits still refuse. Self-host images pin PostgreSQL clients outside the selected machine home so an import resolves the packaged tools under Compose. Repository folders, external services and machine-local secrets need separate preparation.
